scenes.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Create ONE polished landscape 3:2 children's storybook painting for BlitzWord chapter 5, The Boy and the Map. The supplied image is the authoritative reference for BOTH the boy's identity and the painting style. Keep exactly this young boy: tousled warm brown hair, rounded rosy cheeks, small nose, warm brown eyes, cream linen shirt with rolled sleeves, moss-green lace-front waistcoat. Match the gentle detailed hand-painted watercolor/gouache look, fine natural ink contours, textured paper, warm honey light, earthy greens and browns. Childlike proportions, expressive but natural face. A full integrated scene, no panels, no labels, no text, no border, no interface, no giant-eyed glossy animation style, no photorealism. The boy must be clearly visible and recognizable, a main subject rather than tiny background detail. His book is large, old, brown leather-bound with cream pages showing a winding blue river and small sketched woodland landmarks. The boy sits at the wooden desk in the same rustic cottage, dipping a white feather quill and drawing a winding river and path in his open map book. Three-quarter close view with both his full face and book clearly shown; diamond-paned window, tiny plant, ink bottle, stacked books and sunlight. Rich, inviting composition with room around his head and hands. This is the chapter cover and beginning, very close to the approved reference's charm and atmosphere.
